items.reason: Detail `s` uses the shared Status menu builder with the detail’s container.
Detail `y` opens the container’s Copy menu without copying immediately.
Detail `m` opens the shared Mute menu over its container.
Both surfaces dispatch `I` through runFlatVerb.
View renders the drain picker when it opens while a detail remains active.
Direct `y` and `p` dispatches are removed from peeks.
The detail keymap no longer handles `p` in either list.
Existing item and artifact `r` menu paths remain intact.
The shared status refusal appears through the detail frame’s dashboard-flash fallback.
The shared copy refusal appears through the detail frame’s dashboard-flash fallback.
The shared mute refusal appears through the detail frame’s dashboard-flash fallback.
Container menus occupy the detail frame’s reserved Block and reduce its body budget.
Detail menus delegate movement and entry dispatch to the existing menu handlers.
Menu Escape clears the menu without clearing the detail.
Detail openers bypass Selection handling and construct singular menus.
`/` starts detail-local filtering, and Enter applies it and restores normal keys.
Item filtering ANDs case-insensitive substring terms across ID, title and type.
Item status is excluded from search fields.
Artifact filtering applies the same grammar to filename and type.
Escape discards the input buffer and reapplies the previously committed term.
Reopening search creates an empty buffer; applying it restores all rows.
The typing handler forwards character keys, including j/k/v/r, to the text field.
Detail synchronization filters rebuilt lists using the active query.
The detail header displays the applied search term.
Zero matches produce a message naming the term and explaining how to clear it.
Artifact availability uses the unfiltered collection, preserving switching after zero matches.
Detail search state is separate and disappears when the detail closes.
Detail hints name r/s/y/m and search, with flat copy hints removed.
Unchanged documentPeekChrome still advertises `y copy name` and artifact `p copy path`.
Typing hints name only apply search, cancel and help.
Detail help includes menus, applicable I, search and conditional clear-search; peek help removes flat copies.
Menu-specific help remains ahead of detail help, and detail typing gains its own branch.

scores.rationale: Shared handlers and focused tests make the change maintainable, but the stale peek hints reveal incomplete acceptance coverage; supplied changes were not executed.
